hypothesis: H1 — Late interaction (LateOn-Code / multi-vector) beats contextual single-vector (CodeRankEmbed) at a viable exchange rate on the multi-dimensional Pareto surface.

deployment_envelope_a_ide_resident.target_platform: 16 GB Developer Laptop (~4 GB reserved for OS/editor/weights)

index_size_at_2m_chunks_gb.description: Total index footprint at 2M chunks (~50M LOC); admits <= 1.88 b/d for multi-vector

incremental_reindex_ms_per_file.description: Interactive latency upon file save (~40 chunks / 8,000 tokens)

benchmarks: agent_retrieval_bench (427 samples, native BCY@4k-32k, 82 no-gold controls)
bright_code (371 queries across pony, leetcode, stackoverflow)

metrics_hierarchy.primary_metric_description: Recall-at-token-budget measures whether relevant code chunks are present within downstream LLM context windows (500 and 2000 tokens).
metrics_hierarchy.secondary_metric_description: NDCG@10 measures rank ordering of retrieved chunks.

decision_rule.primary_test: LateOn-Code (Arm 3) must beat CodeRankEmbed (Arm 2) by more than the paired bootstrap 95% CI on primary recall-at-token-budget metrics (Recall@500 and Recall@2k) on the frozen referee while maintaining non-inferiority on NDCG@10 and satisfying Envelope A resource thresholds.
decision_rule.internal_referee_threshold: Achieved Recall@500, Recall@2k, and NDCG@10 of Arm 2 (CodeRankEmbed) measured on the frozen referee.
decision_rule.fail_branch: If CodeRankEmbed (Arm 2) matches or beats Arm 3 on primary recall within the CI, or if Arm 3 fails Envelope A (e.g. index > 12 GB at 2M chunks at 1.35 b/d, or incremental re-index > 500 ms/file), reject H1/late-interaction, drop WP3, and pivot to Contextual Single-Vector + Chonkie Chunking Optimization.

semantic_703_queries.rationale: Vocabulary mismatch on paraphrased intents lacking exact identifier stems is directly addressed by contextual token-level late interaction.

symbol_204_queries.rationale: Symbol queries are near saturation (NDCG@10 > 0.93) and governed by exact identifier matching and definition boosting; encoder sensitivity is minimal.

architecture_344_queries.rationale: Multi-file structural aggregation challenge. If late-interaction wins disproportionately here rather than semantic, investigate aggregation/chunking confounds.

mechanistic_verification: Gain must concentrate in Semantic. If gain is flat across categories or concentrates in Architecture, suspect multi-file aggregation confounds.
confounds_controlled: Identical Chonkie chunker (CodeChunker for 9 native, TokenChunker for 10 fallback, tokenizer='tiktoken:cl100k_base')
Exact flat brute-force search across all arms (cosine for Arms 1-2, tensor MaxSim for Arm 3; zero ANN/HNSW/PLAID/IVF)
Arm 3 uses ColBERT query augmentation/padding and exact MaxSim sum_{q in Q} max_{d in D} <q, d>
Arm 3 quality evaluated at fp16 (quantization isolated to WP3)
Pure dense retrieval for all 3 arms (no BM25 fusion, no ensembling)
Character offset to line-span fidelity asserted across all chunks
